description: This file defines an interface 'IFatalErrorHandler' in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, for handling fatal error events such as a silo being declared defunct. It provides method signatures for checking if an exception is unexpected and for handling fatal exceptions.

classes.name: IFatalErrorHandler
classes.description: Interface for controlling how fatal errors are handled within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: IsUnexpected
methods.description: Method to determine whether a given exception is unexpected.

methods.name: OnFatalException
methods.description: Method invoked when a fatal exception occurs, for handling cleanup or logging.
